PROTECTED.TITLE: Protected Roles
PROTECTED.DESC: Members with a protected role cannot be punished by moderation commands (Warn, Kick, Ban, Timeout).
PROTECTED.EMPTY: No protected roles configured. All roles can be moderated.
PROTECTED.CONFIRM_REMOVE: Do you really want to remove this protected role?
PROTECTED.HINT: Anyone holding a protected role cannot be warned, kicked or banned through the moderation commands.
PROTECTED.EMPTY_HINT: Without protected roles, every member can be moderated.

LOGS.TITLE: Moderation Logs
LOGS.SUBTITLE: Every warning, kick and ban with its case number
LOGS.EMPTY_HINT: Once moderation steps in, it shows up here.

CHANNEL_RULES.TITLE: Channel-specific Rules
CHANNEL_RULES.DESC: Set different warn limits for individual channels — for example more leeway in meme channels. Where no rule exists, the server-wide limit applies.
CHANNEL_RULES.EMPTY: No channel-specific rules configured. Global settings apply.
CHANNEL_RULES.CONFIRM_REMOVE: Do you really want to remove this channel rule?
CHANNEL_RULES.EMPTY_HINT: Without a specific rule, the basic settings apply everywhere.
CHANNEL_RULES.AUTOMOD_HINT: Exempting channels from AutoMod is not done here but under AutoMod → Exemptions. That is the single place for it.
CHANNEL_RULES.LIMIT_HELP: Leave empty to use the server-wide setting. Threads follow their parent channel’s rule.

NOTES.TITLE: Moderator Notes
NOTES.DESC: Internal notes about users – only visible to moderators. Can contain background information or observations.
NOTES.HINT: Use the search above to find notes for a specific user, or click 'All' to load all notes.
NOTES.CONFIRM_DELETE: Do you really want to delete this note?
